name: qa-automation-framework
description: Full QA automation framework: E2E with Playwright, API with Newman, Performance with k6, CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Allure reports

scripts.test:api: newman run api/collections/api-tests.json -e api/environments/env.json -r allure --reporter-allure-export reports/allure-results
scripts.test:all: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:api
